'''April 2001 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 7 April 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from David Jones's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2040">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-08-parker-april-72001d2040/ parker-april-72001], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 8 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-08-parker-april-72001d2040/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
